observability_triage.rationale: The work-item post-state disambiguates the short confirmation as enabling regular Enter in the headline field. OOXML can expose the headline control by semantic tag and require a multiline text-control declaration, then a package-level mutation can prove two paragraphs remain inside that control after save/reopen.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The headline field is an identifiable Word text content control configured for multiline input, and a regular paragraph break can be stored as two paragraphs inside that same control without splitting or deleting it.

setup: Build dist/template.docx in a fresh workspace.
Select the content control whose normalized semantic tag identifies the headline field.

parameters.mutation: replace headline w:sdtContent with two deterministic paragraphs and reopen the package

expected_observations.subject: paragraphs retained inside the same headline w:sdt after multiline fixture reopen

determinism_controls: Identify the headline control by stable semantic w:tag, not document order or source configuration.
Mutate and reopen only a temporary DOCX copy; verify the same w:tag encloses both paragraphs.

setup: The headline is a single-line w:text control or plain paragraph.
negative_cases.action: Inspect control type and multiline attribute.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails before any source-level flag can be considered.

setup: Adding a second paragraph places it outside or splits the headline control.
negative_cases.action: Reopen the temporary package and count paragraphs under the original tagged w:sdt.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails because regular Enter is not retained within the field.
